mistakes.note: Subject-verb agreement: 'it' is a singular pronoun and requires the singular verb form 'takes'.
mistakes.practice: Complete these sentences with the correct form of 'take': 1. He ____ a lot of photos. 2. They ____ the bus to work.

mistakes.note: Subject-verb agreement and pluralization: 'There' constructions require the verb to agree with the noun that follows. 'Flight' should be pluralized as 'flights'.
mistakes.practice: Correct these sentences: 1. There is a lot of people. 2. There is three apples on the table.

mistakes.note: While understandable, 'make a big dinner' is less formal. 'Prepare a large dinner' is a more sophisticated collocation.
mistakes.practice: Rewrite these sentences using more formal language: 1. She made a good point. 2. He made a mistake.
